name: 2026 NCS LC Age Group Championships
location: Greensboro Aquatic Center, 1925 W. Gate City Blvd., Greensboro, NC 27511

sessions.name: Thursday Timed Finals
sessions.notes: Single-pool session (one 8-lane LCM competition pool). Positive check-in required. 13-14 800M Freestyle check-in by 2:00 PM (swimmers provide own counters); 13-14 800M Freestyle Relay check-in by 2:30 PM, relay cards due 3:30 PM; 11-12 400M IM check-in by 2:15 PM. 800M Freestyle: all heats swim fast to slow, alternating girls/boys. 800M Freestyle Relay: fastest 2 heats of girls swim slow to fast, then fastest 2 heats of boys slow to fast, then remaining heats fast to slow alternating girls/boys. 11-12 400M IM: fastest (up to) 3 heats swim slow to fast alternating girls/boys (heats 1-3); additional heats (4+) swim fast to slow alternating girls/boys.

sessions.name: Friday Preliminaries
sessions.notes: 13-14 Preliminaries. 10-minute break after event 14. 400M IM deck seeded, check-in by 8:00 AM. 400M Freestyle Relay deck seeded, check-in by 8:00 AM, relay cards due 10:00 AM/5:00 PM; fastest heat of girls & boys relay teams swims in Friday Finals, no AM/PM option; remaining relay heats swim slow to fast at the end of this session.

sessions.name: Friday Timed Finals
sessions.notes: Single-pool session. Afternoon session start time subject to change after entries are processed. 11-12/10&U 400M Freestyle deck seeded, check-in by 12:15 PM or 30 minutes before session start (swimmers provide own counters). 11-12 400M Freestyle Relay deck seeded, check-in by 12:15 PM, relay cards due 2:15 PM. 11-12 200M Backstroke (events 17/18) is numbered within this block but is swum interspersed with the Friday evening Finals session, not this session.

sessions.name: Friday Finals
sessions.notes: 13-14 Finals (B Final then A Final) interspersed with 11-12 200M Backstroke, which is deck seeded — up to 3 fastest positively checked-in heats swim slow to fast during this session; heats 4+ swim at the end of this Finals session unless announced otherwise at the Technical Meeting. A non-scored, no-fee 13-14 Para Mixed 100M Event (event 901) is contested during this session per the Athletes with Disabilities policy. 10-minute break before event 15/16. Fastest heat of 13-14 400M Freestyle Relay swims here.

sessions.name: Saturday Preliminaries
sessions.notes: 13-14 Preliminaries. 10-minute break after event 28. 400M Freestyle deck seeded, check-in by 8:00 AM (swimmers provide own counters). 400M Medley Relay deck seeded, check-in by 8:00 AM, relay cards due 10:00 AM/5:00 PM; fastest heat of girls & boys relay teams swims in Saturday Finals, no AM/PM option.

sessions.name: Saturday Timed Finals
sessions.notes: Single-pool session. Afternoon session start time subject to change after entries are processed. 10&U/11-12 Medley Relays deck seeded, check-in by 12:15 PM or 30 minutes before session start, relay cards due 2:15 PM. 11-12 200M Butterfly (events 31/32) is numbered within this block but is swum interspersed with the Saturday evening Finals session, not this session.

sessions.name: Saturday Finals
sessions.notes: 13-14 Finals (B Final then A Final) interspersed with 11-12 200M Butterfly, which is deck seeded — up to 3 fastest positively checked-in heats swim slow to fast during this session; heats 4+ swim at the end of this Finals session unless announced otherwise. A non-scored, no-fee 13-14 Para Mixed 50M Event (event 902) is contested during this session. 10-minute break before event 29/30. Fastest heat of 13-14 400M Medley Relay swims here.

sessions.name: Sunday Preliminaries
sessions.notes: 13-14 Preliminaries. 13-14 1500M Freestyle is deck seeded, check-in by Saturday 6:30 PM — the fastest positively checked-in heat of girls and boys swims in Sunday Finals (no AM/PM option); all other heats swim at the conclusion of this session after a 10-minute break, fast to slow alternating girls/boys. Swimmers must provide their own counters for the 1500M Freestyle.

sessions.name: Sunday Timed Finals
sessions.notes: Single-pool session. Afternoon session start time subject to change after entries are processed. 11-12 200M Breaststroke (events 41/42) is numbered within this block but is swum interspersed with the Sunday evening Finals session, not this session.

sessions.name: Sunday Finals
sessions.notes: 13-14 1500M Freestyle (fastest checked-in heat of girls & boys only, no AM/PM option) opens the session, followed by 13-14 Finals (B Final then A Final) interspersed with 11-12 200M Breaststroke, which is deck seeded — up to 3 fastest positively checked-in heats swim slow to fast; heats 4+ swim at the end of this Finals session unless announced otherwise. A non-scored, no-fee 13-14 Para Mixed 200M Event (event 903) is contested during this session. No awards ceremony for 13-14 age group at this meet.
